articles.title: Why the First Five Years Are Crucial for Brain Development
articles.excerpt: Why everyday conversation, responsive care, rest and play matter more than pressure to achieve early.
articles.image_alt: Learning and play at the Dolphin Kids campus
paragraphs: Why everyday conversation, responsive care, rest and play matter more than pressure to achieve early.

At Dolphin Kids, these ideas show up in ordinary classroom moments: conversation, play, rest and routines. Parents can try one small change at home and talk with teachers about what the child is already practising at school.

This note is guidance, not a diagnosis. If you are worried about hearing, speech, movement or behaviour, speak with a qualified professional. The school can share classroom observations and help you plan the next conversation.
